posts.title: Recovering data from a dead website via the Wayback Machine
posts.description: In my last post I encouraged everyone to archive websites while they’re still around. It’s easy! It’s approachable! Well… what if you, like me, procrastinated until the site’s already gone? You’re not actually out of options, but it’s not so easy, and it’s not so approachable. And, yet, it’s possible.
